title: Gaussian density vanishes at positive infinity
statement: For every real mean $\mu$ and every positive variance $v$, the density at $x$ of the Gaussian distribution with mean $\mu$ and variance $v$ tends to $0$ as $x$ tends to positive infinity.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a nonnegative real number whose underlying real value is positive
